name: v1 · 26 Oct design
summary: AF7, AF8, Fz, Pz. TP9 + TP10 linked as reference, Fpz ground. Saline sponge pods, forehead heart sensor. Includes AR and try-on.
status: Retired by D24 in the research plan

name: v2 · 29 Oct research plan
summary: Fp1, Fp2, Fz, Pz, TP10, eye (VEOG). TP9 reference alone, Fpz bias. Hydrogel on the forehead, semi-dry pods in hair, earlobe heart-sensor clip. Realistic 540 mm head with all 10-10 sites measured.

name: v3 · 29 Oct review
summary: Fp1, Fp2, Fz, Pz, M2, eye (VEOG). M1 mastoid-bone reference on SRB2, Fpz bias, gain 12. One snap socket per site with swappable inserts: paste on the forehead, semi-dry pods in hair. Test kit toggle adds ECG on channel 7 and dry comparison inserts.
status: Superseded by v4 (7 Nov product design)

name: v4 · 7 Nov product design
summary: The launch design (v4.4): a 5-minute in-clinic session at baseline, day 7 and every visit. Fp1, Fp2, Fz, Cz, Pz, M2, eye (VEOG); M1 reference, Fpz bias. Single-use hydrogel forehead strip placed by a nasion template, earlobe heart clip. Buildable frame for 500–580 mm circumference and 300–390 mm nasion–inion: bought ratchet harness with a 3 mm lining or 7 mm small-head insert, midline band 3D-printed in the head's curve with a TPU tail, spring-loaded semi-dry pods pinned at one size number (1–9); damp single-use foam tips with top-up drops when the app's wetting check asks. Session walkthrough, fit sliders, buy/print parts list.

name: v5 · 7 Nov trial: side box
summary: v4.4 with one change: the main board moves out of the brow module into a printed box above the left ear. The board is rev B (the rev A circuit in pcb/ with the v4 changes, about 90 × 60 mm with an ESP32-S3 DevKit on sockets), too big for the brow module, and the back of the head is taken by the ratchet knob and the band lock. Smaller brow module with a lead hub, one cable along the halo to the box, BMI270 on the board, board guide rewritten for rev B.
